sections.headline: How we work
body: We work with partner farms in Devgad, Maharashtra. We never use carbide, so every mango ripens naturally.
Each box is packed by hand. Customers rate us 4.7 out of 5 from 860 reviews, and that rating is why we keep going.

We pick when the fruit is ready, not when the calendar says so. That is why a box ships within 48 hours and reaches you in 3 to 5 days. A spoiled box is our problem, so we replace it free when more than 2 mangoes go bad.
